prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I still laugh about that Guangzhou trip in 2025—everyone kept arguing about where to eat, like it was a sport.
And the work travel right after that was a blur—I was going from Beijing to Shanghai, basically living out of a carry-on.
Oh, and I remember skimming a medicine info page back then because my throat was acting up—nothing dramatic, just me overthinking it.
My friend had already booked us dinner at Panxi Restaurant for 2025-04-10, so I didn’t have to deal with any of the planning.
It was at 18:00, just 2 of us—she put it under Tang Xue and used 13856781234 for the contact.
For the Shanghai leg, the ticket was already issued too—China Eastern, flight MU5678 on 2025-04-02, passenger name Aiden Miller.
